concerns.text: "System MUST generate a sufficiently large set of synthetic video sequences..." lacks a quantitative definition of "sufficiently large" (e.g., exact number of sequences or total duration), making the requirement untestable.
Success Criteria SC-003 specifies thresholds for SSIM and LPIPS but omits any measurable threshold for PSNR, even though PSNR is listed as a required evaluation metric in FR-004 and US‑03.

The deterministic reproducibility claim (identical results on repeated runs with the same seed) does not describe a concrete verification procedure (e.g., compare file hashes or checksum of rendered frames), leaving the test ambiguous.
